gloss: way of holding; how to hold; grip

definitions.gloss: way of holding; how to hold something; grip
definitions.explanation: The manner in which something is held or gripped. From the verb stem {持|も}ち (holding) plus the suffix 〜{方|かた} (way of doing).

examples.japanese: ⟦お{箸|はし}→お箸：10275_ohashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: To learn how to hold chopsticks.
My way of holding the pen is poor.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラケット→ラケット：00351_raketto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えたら→変える：01089_kaeru⟧、⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: After I changed my grip on the racket, the ball started flying better.

notes:
Formed from the verb stem ⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ plus 〜⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ ('way of ~'), a productive pattern that attaches to almost any verb stem.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{方|かた}: how to hold chopsticks
- {持|も}ち{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧: to teach how to hold something

RELATED PATTERN:
〜⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ forms 'how to' nouns from verbs: ⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧ (how to make), ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧ (how to use), ⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧ (how to write).
